"""Mock C1 emitter: publishes 20 plants on miner/{id}/vision at 1 Hz, as vision-twin would.

    python -m mock.c1_vision [--drop 3 --fake 12 --swap 5:neem --unknown 42 --frozen]

Lets miner-core run without the camera; vision-twin ships the real one.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import logging
import time

from minerd.config import Config
from minerd.mqtt import Bus, topic
from simulator.plants import MockVision


def main() -> None:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    p.add_argument("--drop", type=int, action="append", default=[], help="remove this tag 10 s after start")
    p.add_argument("--fake", type=int, action="append", default=[], help="tag is a plastic plant")
    p.add_argument("--swap", action="append", default=[], help="TAG:species, sticker moved to another plant")
    p.add_argument("--unknown", type=int, action="append", default=[], help="unregistered sticker in view")
    p.add_argument("--frozen", action="store_true", help="repeat the same frame hash")
    p.add_argument("--count", type=int, default=0, help="stop after N messages (0 = forever)")
    args = p.parse_args()
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(levelname)s %(name)s: %(message)s")

    cfg = Config.from_env()
    reg = cfg.registration()
    vision = MockVision(reg.miner_id, reg.sticker_ids)
    start = int(time.time() * 1000)
    vision.faults.dropped = {t: start + 10_000 for t in args.drop}
    vision.faults.fake = set(args.fake)
    vision.faults.swapped = {int(s.split(":")[0]): s.split(":")[1] for s in args.swap}
    vision.faults.unknown_tags = set(args.unknown)
    vision.faults.frozen = args.frozen

    bus = Bus(cfg.mqtt_host, cfg.mqtt_port, "mock-c1").start()
    t = topic(reg.miner_id, "vision")
    print(f"publishing C1 to {t} on {cfg.mqtt_host}:{cfg.mqtt_port} (Ctrl+C to stop)")
    n = 0
    try:
        while not args.count or n < args.count:
            bus.publish(t, vision.message(int(time.time() * 1000)))
            n += 1
            time.sleep(1 - time.time() % 1)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        bus.stop()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Mock C2 emitter for vision-twin and chain-market: real-shaped telemetry and epoch messages.

    python -m mock.c2_emitter [--scenario rush_hour] [--cycle 3] [--reject-every 5] [--drop 7 --fake 12]

Runs the real miner pipeline in real time on simulated sensors and mock plants, and publishes
  miner/{id}/telemetry  every second (QoS 0)
  miner/{id}/epoch      when an epoch closes (QoS 1, retained), re-published as the attestation
                        moves pending -> submitted -> accepted (or rejected)
The validator is NOT called: the attestation is signed, but the tx_hash is made up.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import logging
import os
import threading
import time

from minerd.config import Config
from minerd.mockrun import build_engine
from minerd.mqtt import Bus, topic
from minerd.signer import Signer
from simulator.scenarios import SCENARIOS

log = logging.getLogger("mock.c2")


def main() -> None:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    p.add_argument("--scenario", default="clean_morning", choices=sorted(SCENARIOS))
    p.add_argument("--cycle", type=int, default=0, help="switch to the next scenario every N epochs")
    p.add_argument("--reject-every", type=int, default=0, help="mark every Nth epoch rejected")
    p.add_argument("--drop", type=int, action="append", default=[], help="remove this tag after 30 s")
    p.add_argument("--fake", type=int, action="append", default=[], help="tag is a plastic plant")
    p.add_argument("--duration", type=int, default=0, help="stop after N seconds (0 = forever)")
    args = p.parse_args()
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(levelname)s %(name)s: %(message)s")

    cfg = Config.from_env()
    engine, vision = build_engine(cfg, args.scenario)
    signer = Signer(cfg.device_key())
    start = int(time.time() * 1000)
    vision.faults.dropped = {t: start + 30_000 for t in args.drop}
    vision.faults.fake = set(args.fake)

    bus = Bus(cfg.mqtt_host, cfg.mqtt_port, "mock-c2").start()
    t_tel, t_epoch = topic(engine.miner_id, "telemetry"), topic(engine.miner_id, "epoch")
    print(f"publishing C2 to {t_tel} and {t_epoch} on {cfg.mqtt_host}:{cfg.mqtt_port} (Ctrl+C to stop)")
    scenarios = list(SCENARIOS)
    closed_count = 0

    def lifecycle(result, att, reject: bool) -> None:
        base = {"evidence_hash": att["evidence_hash"], "amount": att["amount"]}
        for status in ("pending", "submitted"):
            bus.publish(t_epoch, result.c2_epoch({"status": status, **base}), qos=1, retain=True)
            time.sleep(1.5)
        if reject:
            final = {"status": "rejected", **base, "reason_code": "gps_outside_geofence",
                     "reason": "mock rejection (c2_emitter --reject-every)"}
        else:
            final = {"status": "accepted", **base, "tx_hash": "0x" + os.urandom(32).hex()}
        bus.publish(t_epoch, result.c2_epoch(final), qos=1, retain=True)
        log.info("epoch %s %s: %s AIR", result.epoch, final["status"], result.total_air)

    try:
        while not args.duration or time.time() * 1000 - start < args.duration * 1000:
            now = int(time.time() * 1000)
            engine.ingest_vision(vision.message(now), now)
            telemetry, closed = engine.tick(now)
            telemetry["uplink"] = {"online": True, "queued_attestations": 0}
            bus.publish(t_tel, telemetry)
            if closed is not None:
                closed_count += 1
                att = signer.sign(closed.c3_unsigned(engine.cat.calibration_hash))
                reject = bool(args.reject_every) and closed_count % args.reject_every == 0
                threading.Thread(target=lifecycle, args=(closed, att, reject), daemon=True).start()
                if args.cycle and closed_count % args.cycle == 0:
                    nxt = scenarios[(scenarios.index(engine.sensors.scenario) + 1) % len(scenarios)]
                    engine.sensors.set_scenario(nxt)
                    log.info("scenario -> %s", nxt)
            time.sleep(1 - time.time() % 1)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        time.sleep(0.5)
        bus.stop()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Mock C3 emitter for chain-market: signed attestations to print or POST to a validator.

    python -m mock.c3_emitter                                  # print one attestation
    python -m mock.c3_emitter --post http://localhost:3001     # POST /v1/attestations
    python -m mock.c3_emitter --post ... --tamper amount       # expect bad_signature
    python -m mock.c3_emitter --post ... --count 5 --interval 60

Each attestation is the last closed epoch at send time, built from mock inputs and signed with
the miner's device key, so a validator on the local chain should accept it.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import logging
import time

import httpx

from minerd.config import EPOCH_MS, Config
from minerd.mockrun import build_engine, run_epoch
from minerd.signer import Signer
from simulator.scenarios import SCENARIOS

TAMPER = {
    "amount": lambda a: a.update(amount=str(int(a["amount"]) * 10)),
    "epoch": lambda a: a.update(epoch=a["epoch"] - 1),
    "plant": lambda a: a["plants"][0].update(air=a["plants"][0]["air"] + 1),
    "gps": lambda a: a["gps"].update(lat=a["gps"]["lat"] + 0.01),
    "signature": lambda a: a.update(signature=a["signature"][:-4] + ("1b" if a["signature"][-2:] != "1b" else "1c")
                                    + a["signature"][-2:]),
}


def build(cfg: Config, scenario: str, epoch: int, tamper: str | None) -> dict:
    engine, vision = build_engine(cfg, scenario)
    result = run_epoch(engine, vision, epoch)
    att = Signer(cfg.device_key()).sign(result.c3_unsigned(engine.cat.calibration_hash))
    if tamper:
        TAMPER[tamper](att)
    return att


def main() -> None:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    p.add_argument("--scenario", default="festival_smog", choices=sorted(SCENARIOS))
    p.add_argument("--post", metavar="VALIDATOR_URL", help="POST to {url}/v1/attestations instead of printing")
    p.add_argument("--tamper", choices=sorted(TAMPER), help="break one field after signing")
    p.add_argument("--count", type=int, default=1)
    p.add_argument("--interval", type=float, default=60, help="seconds between attestations")
    args = p.parse_args()
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.WARNING, format="%(levelname)s %(name)s: %(message)s")
    cfg = Config.from_env()

    for i in range(args.count):
        if i:
            time.sleep(args.interval)
        epoch = int(time.time() * 1000) // EPOCH_MS - 1
        att = build(cfg, args.scenario, epoch, args.tamper)
        if not args.post:
            print(json.dumps(att, indent=2))
            continue
        url = args.post.rstrip("/") + "/v1/attestations"
        try:
            r = httpx.post(url, json=att, timeout=30)
            print(f"epoch {epoch} amount {att['amount']} -> HTTP {r.status_code} {r.text}")
        except httpx.HTTPError as e:
            print(f"epoch {epoch} -> {url} unreachable: {e}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
